scope: Static process-frame count and capacity gate; no ADM-to-frame count join or runtime result

upstream.wash_independent_verification: all five payload hashes and sizes match manifest and seal

count.meaning: number of channel pointer entries in the frame view

staging.multi_entry_copy_guard: no count<=16 guard found before the copy in checked scope

frame_view.narrowing: count converted to U32 after staging and placed into a one-group descriptor

downstream_capacity_gate.source: custom i32 key/value pair or selected-profile fallback table
downstream_capacity_gate.ordering: this gate occurs after wrapper pointer-list staging

36_38_disposition.conditional_static_risk: if N=36 or 38 reaches the multi-entry loop, it exceeds local_d8[16] extent

implementation_guidance: Keep ADM track count distinct from native frame-view count until a typed mapping is established.
Use dynamically sized owned storage for variable ADM rows.
Check count against storage capacity before copying.
prohibited_inferences: Do not claim that the 36-track ADM reaches this frame-view count.
Do not claim the static staging risk was observed as a runtime overwrite.
Do not treat the downstream key-2 capacity gate as proof that earlier staging is safe.
